experts.random_eligibility: at least 50 routes on registered validation sequences and not in top16
experts.random_replay: enumerate eligible expert IDs in ascending numeric order, then numpy.random.default_rng(260814).choice(candidate_ids, size=16, replace=False); preserve returned order

common_probe.source: registered 10000-token layer-one capture calibration sequences only
common_probe.selection: exclude calibration sequences shorter than six tokens; sequence round-robin over the remaining sequences; six evenly spaced token positions per sequence, ordered by round then capture sequence; truncate after 512

gate.weak_no_go_extreme_pooling: fewer than 50 percent of neurons have normalized replacement cost C <= 0.10
gate.strong: at least 75 percent have C <= 0.10 AND at least 50 percent have C <= 0.05
gate.ambiguous: between weak and strong; run one predeclared 64-expert replication before clustering
